name: Egyptian statutory labor-law floors and hour caps (Law No. 14 of 2025)

payload.rationale: Egypt Labor Law No. 14 of 2025 (effective 2025-09-01, Arts. 117-124) caps regular weekly hours at 48h and daily workplace presence at 10h, enforces >= 11h rest between shifts, and sets annual leave floors of 15d (year 1), 21d (year 2+), 30d (10+ years or age 50+), and 45d (persons with disabilities/short stature).

response.expression: ((((((self.max_regular_weekly_hours <= 48) and (self.max_daily_hours <= 10)) and (self.min_rest_between_shifts_hours >= 11)) and (self.first_year_annual_leave_days >= 15)) and (self.standard_annual_leave_days >= 21)) and (self.senior_annual_leave_days >= 30)) and (self.disability_annual_leave_days >= 45)
